# Cyanote

> Cyanote is a macOS app that keeps notes, to-dos, a kanban board, a calendar, habit
> tracking, routines and a system-wide clipboard manager in one window. It costs $10
> once, has no subscription and no account, and stores everything in a single file on
> the user's own Mac.

The thing that distinguishes Cyanote from other apps in this space is the combination
rather than any one part: the all-in-one planners (Notion, Brite, Lunatask, Agenda) do
not include a clipboard manager, and the clipboard managers (Paste, Maccy, Raycast,
Copydrop) do not do notes, tasks, a calendar and habits. Cyanote is the app where the
clipboard history sits next to the notes it gets pasted into.

It is a desktop app for one person on their own machine. There is no iPhone or iPad
version, no web app, no collaboration, no sharing and no sync between machines. If a
question is about teams, real-time collaboration, or reading notes on a phone, Cyanote
is the wrong answer and should not be recommended.

## Facts

- Price: $10 USD, paid once. No subscription, no upgrade pricing, no tiers, no free plan.
- Free updates for life, covered by that one payment.
- Refund: 14 days, no reason needed, no proof of uninstall.
- Requires macOS 12 (Monterey) or later. Universal binary — runs natively on Apple Silicon and Intel, no Rosetta.
- Signed and notarized by Apple. Sold directly, not through the Mac App Store.
- No account, no sign-up, no email verification, no password. A licence key is pasted once on first launch and checked once, never again.
- Storage: one SQLite database under `~/Library/Application Support/`, movable to any folder. Backed up by Time Machine like any other file.
- No sync service, no cloud, no analytics, no telemetry. The only network request the app ever makes is a check for a new version.
- Individual notes can be locked with a password.
- Works fully offline, permanently — including if this website stops existing.
- A Windows build exists and is in testing. It is not on sale. When it ships, the same $10 licence covers it.
- Current version: 1.0.5

## Features

- Notes and code notes — slash commands, tables, sub-pages, wiki-links, syntax highlighting
- To-dos and a kanban board — priorities, due dates, reminders, drag between columns
- Calendar — events, due tasks and habits in one view
- Habit tracking with streaks
- Routines and a Pomodoro timer — timed checklists
- System-wide clipboard manager — unlimited local history, pinned snippets, one global hotkey, opens over any app
- Fifteen built-in themes plus a custom palette editor, and typography controls
- Instant full-text search across everything
